meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你管理消息频道与智能体组的连接：查看当前配置、添加新频道、修改频道归属、设置隔离级别，并显示所有频道和用户权限的摘要。
howto.when: 当你需要配置或调整消息频道（如 Telegram、Slack）与智能体组的连接时触发，例如添加新频道、更改频道归属或查看当前配置。

say.text: 帮我查看当前所有频道和智能体组的连接情况。
say.note: Claude 会查询数据库并显示摘要。

say.text: 把 Telegram 群“项目讨论”连接到智能体组“客服组”。
添加一个新的 Discord 频道，隔离级别设为“独立智能体”。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成注册步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage connections between messaging channels and agent groups: view current configuration, add new channels, change channel assignments, set isolation levels, and display a summary of all channels and user permissions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to configure or adjust connections between messaging channels (e.g., Telegram, Slack) and agent groups, such as adding a new channel, changing channel assignment, or viewing current configuration.

say_en.text: Show me the current connections between all channels and agent groups.
say_en.note: Claude will query the database and display a summary.

say_en.text: Connect the Telegram group "Project Chat" to the agent group "Support Team".
say_en.note: Claude will change the channel assignment.

say_en.text: Add a new Discord channel with isolation level "Separate Agent".
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the registration steps.
